scope.rule: County-level source research does not approve a parcel/site AOI or authorize a hydraulic model run.

EFFECTIVE_FEMA_NFHL.regulatoryRole: effective FEMA flood-hazard product; verify community/panel effective date and applicable product metadata at time of use
prohibited: claiming site-specific determination without overlay and review
silently relabeling as effective FEMA NFHL

use: advisory only after source/version and data artifacts are verified
prohibited: presenting as an acquired or validated dataset based only on a catalog/manifest entry

USGS_SIR_2016_5119.identity: Fowler, 2016, Flood-Inundation Maps for the Wabash River at New Harmony, Indiana
verticalReference: gage stage on a gage-specific datum
prohibited: transferring calibration to another reach/site without independent data and validation
treating gage stage as NAVD88 elevation

USACE_ERDC_CHL_TR_22_4.identity: Wabash and Ohio River Confluence Hydraulic and Sediment Transport Model Investigation
USACE_ERDC_CHL_TR_22_4.model: Adaptive Hydraulics (AdH), 2D shallow-water hydraulics and sediment transport
prohibited: reusing study calibration as site calibration
inferring site bathymetry, bed gradation, boundary conditions, or validated output from the report alone

FEMA_VERTICAL_DATUM_GUIDANCE_MAY_2014.rule: Never apply an undocumented fixed offset. Record source and target vertical datum, method, conversion tool/model and version, geographic scope, factor(s), units, uncertainty/variation, and reviewer disposition.

requiredChecks: CRS and vertical-datum semantics are explicit or explicitly UNKNOWN
AOI geometry and source coverage/bounds reconciled
required source counts reconciled; zero results fail closed when a nonzero minimum is required
atomic publication only after every required validation succeeds
acquisitionGate.promotionRule: NOT_ACQUIRED or ACQUIRED_UNVERIFIED data must never be presented as VALIDATED or PUBLISHED. Partial manifests must not be promoted.

publicationGate.minimumFeatureCountPolicy: Per-source explicit minimum; zero is valid only when explicitly declared and justified.

horizontalDatumGate.currentOfficialReference: NAD 83 (2011), epoch 2010.00 for the conterminous United States, subject to NGS regional realization rules
horizontalDatumGate.legacyReference: NAD 27 and older NAD 83 realizations may occur in historic/topographic products and legacy datasets
rules: A projected CRS identifier and a horizontal reference frame are distinct metadata; preserve both.
A horizontal CRS or NAD 83 label does not identify the vertical datum or make ellipsoidal heights orthometric elevations.
Do not silently relabel NAD 27, NAD 83 realizations, WGS 84, ITRF, or modernized NSRS coordinates as interchangeable.
Record any coordinate transformation, input/output frames and epochs, operation/pipeline, grid files and versions, units, stated accuracy, and validation residuals.

verticalHeightGate.currentOfficialVerticalDatumCONUS: NAVD 88 per NOAA NGS current-datum reference page; reconfirm current status and product metadata at processing time
verticalHeightGate.localReference: GAGE_DATUM is station-specific and must be read from the station metadata; raw gage height is not NAVD 88 elevation

ellipsoidalHeight.definition: GNSS-derived height relative to a named reference ellipsoid and compatible geometric reference frame

orthometricHeight.definition: Elevation relative to a named vertical datum/geopotential reference; NAVD 88 is the current CONUS example on the NGS reference page

geoidHeight.definition: Separation/undulation between the specified ellipsoid and a compatible geoid model surface

relationship.qualification: Use only as the geoid-model relationship for compatible frames, datum, epoch, location, units, and model. Do not turn it into a universal constant-offset rule.

geoidModelCompatibility.role: hybrid geoid model supporting conversion of compatible NAD 83 (2011), epoch 2010.00 ellipsoid heights to orthometric heights consistent with NAVD 88 in CONUS
incompatibleInputs: other NAD 83 realizations without a documented transformation
geoidModelCompatibility.accuracyNote: NGS model-fit estimated uncertainty does not represent the complete accuracy of NAVD 88 heights; account for ellipsoid-height uncertainty, datum/model limitations, and independent control.

observedStatusFromOfficialPage.NCATBeta2: PENDING_FOR_BETA_RELEASE; future transformations include current-to-modernized reference frames and vertical datums

datumModernizationGate.rule: Beta feedback completion is not itself proof of operational adoption. Keep existing source datum identity until NGS publishes formal adoption/version guidance and the production transformation tools support the required operation.

topographicReferenceSources.authority: USGS National Geologic Map Database / National Geospatial Program
topographicReferenceSources.scope: TopoView exposes US Topo-series maps from 2009 onward and historical topographic map editions; map dates/editions must be retained.
prohibitedUse: treating the rendered/map PDF as a current bare-earth DEM
using contours or scanned map pixels as validated hydraulic terrain without separate georeferencing, datum, resolution, and accuracy validation

topographicReferenceSources.product: Layered geospatial PDF 7.5-minute quadrangle map collection
prohibitedUse: asserting downloaded local artifacts or coverage from catalog metadata alone
substituting map graphics for source terrain rasters, surveyed bathymetry, or authoritative vertical control
